::: {#def-subtree}
#### Subtree

Let $T$ be a rooted tree (@def-rooted-tree), and let $v$ be a vertex of $T$.
The **subtree** of $T$ rooted at $v$ [@wikipedia_tree_graph_theory] is the subgraph (@def-subgraph) of $T$
whose vertices are $v$ and its descendants (@def-descendant),
and whose edges are the edges of $T$ with both endpoints among those vertices,
with $v$ as its root.

:::
